summary: Full end-to-end validation of new per-vendor Purchase Order flow (backend PDF endpoint + email endpoint w/ subject/body overrides, and DealActionBar 'Create PO' split button + PurchaseOrderComposeModal). Created TEST_ vendors + TEST_ deals only; real deal 0515ecd5-f02d-4926-8240-46a13404d408 was NOT touched. All 8 backend pytest cases and all frontend Playwright assertions passed. Gmail IS configured in this pod so the email endpoint returned 200 and actually delivered.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> is being rendered as a child of <option> in ProjectPhotos.jsx line 442 (dev-instrumentation wrapping). Not related to this PO feature but shows up in every deal-detail console. Low priority — cosmetic dev warning.

critical_code_review_comments: DealActionBar.jsx line 544: `useState(vendor.vendor_email || '')` — the group object from poVendorGroups never sets vendor_email, so this initializer is always empty and relies on the follow-up GET /vendors/{id}. Minor — works, but the `vendor_email` fallback is dead code.

server.py email_purchase_order: If Gmail send fails, exception is caught and re-raised as HTTPException 500 with the raw exception message including EmailNotConfigured class name. Acceptable but leaks internal class name to clients — consider mapping EmailNotConfigured → 503 for clearer semantics.

DealActionBar.jsx: When poVendorGroups is empty, the Create PO primary button calls `goToTakeoff` AND the split-button also mounts a caret. Both work but the visual double-button width feels slightly inconsistent with the takeoff-populated variant (which is caret-only trigger). Not a bug.
backend/server.py line 2604 `override_body_text = body.get('body_text')` — treats empty string as 'use default'; that's fine and matches frontend intent, just worth noting for future callers.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created TEST_Vendor_A_POFlow, TEST_Vendor_B_POFlow, TEST_NoEmailVendor_*, and TEST_PO_flow_* / TEST_PO_empty_* deals. Frontend Playwright created TEST_Vendor_A_FE_*, TEST_Vendor_B_FE_*, TEST_PO_FE_* and TEST_PO_FE_empty_* deals. All TEST_ prefixed for easy cleanup. Real deal 0515ecd5-f02d-4926-8240-46a13404d408 was verified untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_purchase_order.py. They require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported from frontend/.env before running (`export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs)` then `pytest backend/tests/test_purchase_order.py`). Gmail is configured in this pod — email endpoint actually delivers, so avoid using real vendor emails in tests. The frontend request-intercept pattern used in this iteration confirms the compose modal correctly POSTs edited subject/body/to_email in the request payload.
